raw_contexts.title: KIMN
raw_contexts.paragraph_text: KIMN (100.3 FM, "Mix 100.3") is a Hot AC radio station in Denver, Colorado. The station broadcasts at 100.3 MHz with an effective radiated power of 97 kW and is under ownership of Stan Kroenke's KSE Radio Ventures. Its studios are located on Colorado Boulevard in Glendale, and the transmitter site is on Mount Morrison west of Lakewood.
